steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1'); localStorage.removeItem('hdb_dismissed_callouts') })()

steps.name: P18-probe-collapsed
steps.eval: (() => { const d=document.querySelector('.panel.inspector details.compose'); console.log('PROBE disclosure open(before)', d && d.open) })()

steps.name: P18-expand-disclosure
steps.eval: (() => { const s=[...document.querySelectorAll('.panel.inspector .compose-summary')].find(el => /Apartment colour palette/.test(el.textContent||'')); if(!s) throw new Error('palette summary not found'); s.click() })()

steps.name: P18-probe-expanded
steps.eval: (() => { const d=document.querySelector('.panel.inspector details.compose'); console.log('PROBE disclosure open(after)', d && d.open) })()

steps.name: P18b-walk-mode-overlay-shown
steps.failMessage: 'Entering walkthrough' splash never appeared, so the gone-wait below would pass vacuously. If this transition genuinely raises no splash (same mode, or the room editor owns the overlay) delete BOTH guard steps rather than widening the timeout.

steps.name: P18b-walk-mode-overlay-gone
steps.failMessage: 'Entering walkthrough' splash still up; the next screenshot would capture the splash, not the scene. See docs/visual-verification-playbook.md.

steps.name: P18b-probe-readout-a
steps.eval: (() => { const r=[...document.querySelectorAll('.fld')].find(f => /Field of view/.test(f.textContent||'')); const val=r && r.querySelector('.val'); console.log('PROBE fov readout A', val && val.textContent) })()

steps.name: P18b-probe-readout-b
steps.eval: (() => { const r=[...document.querySelectorAll('.fld')].find(f => /Field of view/.test(f.textContent||'')); const val=r && r.querySelector('.val'); console.log('PROBE fov readout B', val && val.textContent) })()

steps.name: P18b-back-orbit-overlay-shown
steps.failMessage: 'Switching to overview' splash never appeared, so the gone-wait below would pass vacuously. If this transition genuinely raises no splash (same mode, or the room editor owns the overlay) delete BOTH guard steps rather than widening the timeout.

steps.name: P18b-back-orbit-overlay-gone
steps.failMessage: 'Switching to overview' splash still up; the next screenshot would capture the splash, not the scene. See docs/visual-verification-playbook.md.

steps.name: P32-progress-start
steps.eval: (() => { window.__b3bToastId = window.__store.getState().notify.start({ kind:'progress', title:'Rendering…', message:'Path-tracing your view', progress: 0.15, onActivate: () => { window.__b3bJumped = true } }) })()

steps.name: P32-probe-retry
steps.eval: (() => { const act=document.querySelector('.toast-host .toast-act'); console.log('PROBE retry action', act && act.textContent) })()

steps.name: P38-probe-dataset
steps.eval: (() => { const d=document.documentElement.dataset.density; if(d!=='compact') throw new Error('dataset.density not compact: '+d); console.log('PROBE dataset.density', d) })()

steps.name: P38-probe-rowpad-compact
steps.eval: (() => { const mi=document.querySelector('.menu-item'); const cs=mi&&getComputedStyle(mi); console.log('PROBE compact .menu-item padding', cs && cs.padding) })()

steps.name: P38-probe-rowpad-comfort
steps.eval: (() => { const mi=document.querySelector('.menu-item'); const cs=mi&&getComputedStyle(mi); console.log('PROBE comfortable .menu-item padding', cs && cs.padding) })()

steps.name: P38-probe-density-absent
steps.eval: (() => { const labels=[...document.querySelectorAll('.pop-label')].map(e => e.textContent.trim()); if(labels.includes('Density')) throw new Error('Density seg present in Simple mode'); console.log('PROBE simple pop-labels', JSON.stringify(labels)) })()

steps.name: P26-probe-upsell
steps.eval: (() => { const u=document.querySelector('.cmdk-upsell'); const chip=u&&u.querySelector('.badge.neutral'); console.log('PROBE upsell text', u && u.textContent.replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim(), '| chip', chip && chip.textContent) })()

steps.name: P26-probe-upsell-absent
steps.eval: (() => { const u=document.querySelector('.cmdk-upsell'); if(u) throw new Error('upsell present in Pro mode'); console.log('PROBE upsell absent in Pro', u===null) })()

steps.name: P7-probe-gate-high
steps.eval: (() => { const s=window.__store.getState(); const gate = !!s.featureFlags.ambientFx && s.qualityTier !== 'performance'; console.log('PROBE ambientFx gate @high', gate, 'flag', s.featureFlags.ambientFx, 'tier', s.qualityTier) })()

steps.name: P7-gradient-high
steps.eval: (() => { const card=document.querySelector('.card-grid .cat-card'); if(!card) throw new Error('no cat-card'); const bg=getComputedStyle(card).backgroundImage; if(!/radial-gradient/.test(bg)) throw new Error('gradient CSS not applied: '+bg); const r=card.getBoundingClientRect(); card.style.setProperty('--mx', Math.round(r.width*0.30)+'px'); card.style.setProperty('--my', Math.round(r.height*0.28)+'px'); console.log('PROBE high-tier gradient bg', bg.slice(0,58), '| accent-oklch', /oklch/.test(bg), '| offset --mx', card.style.getPropertyValue('--mx')) })()

steps.name: P7-inject-beam-high
steps.eval: (() => { const host=document.querySelector('.card-grid .cat-card') || document.querySelector('.panel.catalog'); host.style.position='relative'; host.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend',''); const beam=host.querySelector('.beam'); const cs=getComputedStyle(beam,'::before'); console.log('PROBE beam ::before anim', cs.animationName, 'offsetPath', cs.offsetPath, 'dur', cs.animationDuration, 'playState', cs.animationPlayState) })()

steps.name: P7-probe-gate-perf
steps.eval: (() => { const s=window.__store.getState(); const gate = !!s.featureFlags.ambientFx && s.qualityTier !== 'performance'; if(gate) throw new Error('ambientFx gate still true at performance tier'); console.log('PROBE ambientFx gate @performance', gate, 'tier', s.qualityTier) })()

steps.name: P7-clear-gradient-perf
steps.eval: (() => { const card=document.querySelector('.card-grid .cat-card'); if(!card) throw new Error('no cat-card'); card.style.removeProperty('--mx'); card.style.removeProperty('--my'); console.log('PROBE performance-tier gradient inert (vars cleared) --mx', JSON.stringify(card.style.getPropertyValue('--mx'))) })()

steps.name: RM-probe-beam-static
steps.eval: (() => { const host=document.querySelector('.toolbar')||document.body; host.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend',''); const beam=document.getElementById('rm-beam'); const cs=getComputedStyle(beam,'::before'); console.log('PROBE RM beam ::before dur', cs.animationDuration, 'iter', cs.animationIterationCount); beam.remove() })()

steps.name: RM-inject-dot
steps.eval: (() => { const mi=document.querySelector('.menu-item')||document.querySelector('.toolbar button'); mi.style.position='relative'; mi.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend',''); const dot=mi.querySelector('.new-dot'); const cs=getComputedStyle(dot); console.log('PROBE RM new-dot dur', cs.animationDuration, 'iter', cs.animationIterationCount, 'opacity', cs.opacity) })()

steps.name: RM-probe-crossfade
steps.eval: (() => { const el=document.querySelector('.plan-screen'); const cs=el&&getComputedStyle(el); console.log('PROBE RM plan-screen opacity', cs && cs.opacity, 'animDur', cs && cs.animationDuration) })()
